additional_config_fields.label: Sales Order (OData V4) service root URL
additional_config_fields.help: HTTPS URL of the published API_SALESORDER service root, for example https://<host>/sap/opu/odata4/sap/api_salesorder/srvd_a2x/sap/salesorder/0001/.

additional_config_fields.label: SAP system number
additional_config_fields.help: The SAP-issued system number (from SAP for Me or SAP Cloud ALM). It identifies the system and cannot be changed after data is collected.

additional_config_fields.label: SAP client
additional_config_fields.help: Three-digit SAP client. Cannot be changed after data is collected.

additional_config_fields.label: Sales organizations
additional_config_fields.help: Comma-separated sales organization codes to collect, for example 1010,1710. Patterns are not supported.
